en: A black and white vintage postcard showing an aerial view of a town with a river running through it. A prominent church with a pointed façade and rose window is located near the riverbank, surrounded by several low-rise buildings, tree-lined streets, and a bridge crossing the river. The urban area is set against a backdrop of hills and a dense cluster of older buildings. The bottom right of the postcard has the caption 'Trento - Piedicastello.'
